payload.text: SAFETY — pre-trade hard-breach gating (deliverable: limits-breach-detection). LimitCheck::is_hard_breach is a pure, deterministic predicate: it returns true iff BOTH the limit's enforcement == Enforcement::Hard AND its RagStatus utilization status is_breach() — the conjunction that distinguishes a rejectable hard breach from a soft (advisory) warning. It reads only &self (the limit spec + the precomputed utilization), performs no I/O, no mutation, no allocation; identical inputs always yield the identical verdict. This is the exact gate pre_trade_check / post_trade_check funnel through to decide PreTradeDecision::Reject, so a hard limit is enforced (a soft one only warns). Self-invalidates if the enforcement/status conjunction is ever weakened.
